summary.text: Dean Jeffries is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 61, where he has served since 2018, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an insurance agent by profession.

paragraphs.text: Dean Jeffries was born in Charleston, West Virginia, and earned a bachelor's degree in healthcare administration from the University of Charleston in 1995.
His career experience includes working as an insurance agent at State Farm and as an area manager at Sun Healthcare.
Jeffries has served in the House of Delegates since 2018 and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
